content: Sock Shop (microservices-demo/microservices-demo) README is now explicitly marked 'DEPRECATED'; Spring Boot + Go kit + Node, tooling references Weave Scope/Weave Cloud (Weaveworks defunct). Stan's Robot Shop (instana/robot-shop) README self-declares: 'It is not intended to be a comprehensive reference example of how to write a microservices application... the error handling is patchy and there is not any security built into the application.' Robot Shop does have RabbitMQ + polyglot stores (Mongo/Redis/MySQL) but the queue is used for a fire-and-forget dispatch, not a saga. Both are observability-vendor demos, not distributed-systems teaching artifacts.
